extraction.name: VideoChat-Flash: Hierarchical Compression for Long-Context Video Modeling
extraction.description: This paper proposes VideoChat-Flash, a multimodal large language model for long-context video understanding. It introduces a hierarchical video token compression method (HiCo), a multi-stage short-to-long learning scheme, a large-scale dataset LongVid, and a Multi-Hop Needle-In-A-Video-Haystack benchmark. The model achieves leading performance on long and short video benchmarks at 2B and 7B scales.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.citeAs: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, et al. VideoChat-Flash: Hierarchical Compression for Long-Context Video Modeling. arXiv:2501.00574v4, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The LongVid dataset is curated from existing datasets including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData. It comprises 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering pairs across five task types. Data curation involves generating dense event labels for each long video using existing high-quality short video captions and filtering consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For LongVid, we filter consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence. For datasets with high-quality event-level annotations, we directly utilize them as event labels; for others, we extract the major event from the caption using an LLM. We construct QA pairs based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For LongVid, we generate dense event labels for each long video. We utilize existing high-quality short video captions (Panda-70M for HD-VILA, CosMo for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D, and original captions from MiraData). For datasets with high-quality event-level annotations (HT-Step for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D), we directly use them as event labels; for others, we extract the major event from the caption using an LLM. We construct several types of long video QA pairs based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps.
